# AAA Marcel projections (amendment 15; generated by `python -m src.marcel`)

Marcel adapted to AAA: last three AAA seasons (hitters 5/4/3, pitchers 3/2/1), regressed by 1,200 PA / 600 BF of league-average play, age factor; pitchers ranked by projected K% - BB%, hitters by projected wOBA.

## V2: CPBL K-BB% (centred)

**Amendment-11 cohort (pre-arrival, park-adjusted)**, n 17:

| test | n | rho | ci_lo | ci_hi | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marcel K-BB% vs CPBL K-BB% | 17 | 0.29 | -0.14 | 0.62 | inconclusive |
| baseline vs CPBL K-BB% | 17 | 0.17 | -0.29 | 0.57 | inconclusive |

Paired difference Marcel minus the comparator above: +0.11 (90% CI -0.20 to +0.42).

**Census 2018-2026 (PF = 1)**, n 53:

| test | n | rho | ci_lo | ci_hi | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marcel K-BB% vs CPBL K-BB% | 53 | 0.42 | 0.20 | 0.60 | supports |
| CP1 AAA K-BB% vs CPBL K-BB% | 53 | 0.34 | 0.12 | 0.54 | supports |

Paired difference Marcel minus the comparator above: +0.08 (90% CI -0.03 to +0.20).
